features.quote: a plastered pool with a cistern east of it

notes: The sentence puts the ashlar building and the plastered pool with its cistern 'On the western side of the site', so both are W of the site (the cistern is just east of the pool). The Ottoman warm bath, the 'ancient baths' and the hot springs are not described as pools or basins; not coded. The mill/aqueduct 250 m E is not a pool or pit. Plan Fig. 227 does not show the pool. No graves.
